claims: The 48th annual LCMC Health Crescent City Classic took place on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
The 48th annual LCMC Health Crescent City Classic featured over 20,000 runners and walkers, according to reports from FOX 8 and WDSU.
Rolando Ortiz won the 10K race with a time of 31:04.
Annie LeHardy was the top female finisher at 33:55.
The LCMC Health Crescent City Classic began at Champions Square.
The LCMC Health Crescent City Classic concluded in City Park.
Rolando Ortiz (Colombia/Lake Charles, LA) was the winner.
Annie LeHardy (New Orleans, LA) was the top female finisher.
The LCMC Health Crescent City Classic was a sold-out event with over 20,100 participants.
Champions Square is near the Superdome.
The course started at Champions Square near the Superdome.
The course ended in City Park.
The Michelob Ultra RaceFest at City Park featured local music, food, and awards.
The "Run For It" program aims to raise $1 million for local charities.
Road closures were in effect from April 3 at 11:30 PM through April 4 at noon.
Packet Pickup was held at the Hyatt Hotel prior to the race.
